questions.text: Which elevator hoistway statement best matches the checked local source?

options.text: A substantially enclosed hoistway with only necessary openings and no unrelated services.
A general utility shaft shared freely with unrelated piping.

questions.text: What pit condition is required when the elevator car rests on fully compressed buffers?

options.text: The pit may be eliminated if the car is slow.
At least 600 mm clearance remains below the underside of the car.
The hoistway can be used for any unrelated conduit.
Only the cab finish determines the required clearance.

questions.rationale: At least 600 mm clearance remains below the underside of the car. This answer matches Salvan Utilities 2 refined markdown lines 1711-1717.
